errors.error_description: The state machine's case statement omits handling for state S_EXEC, causing an unhandled transition and potential deadlock; the bug is placed on the case line.
The internal wire op_raw is driven by two continuous assignments: a full-vector assignment and a bit-select assignment, creating multiple active drivers on op_raw[2].
A deeply nested if-else chain is used to derive ALU control, increasing combinational depth and degrading synthesis quality; the tag marks one of the inner nested branches.
